changelog:
/do fits content work, and run records count only what the run did.

Features: handoff-path.js write takes --stamp so a run's handoff reuses its plan's stamp. A content-only change outside the gated app (seed data, course text) commits with an audited skip that names the check that verified it, and stays with Main Agent whatever its length (LOC counts code only). Prose that states policy, authority, commands or numbers someone acts on (a course, a runbook, release notes) gets a real review against its sources, not a light read. Finishing a branch reuses a gate receipt that already covers the branch tip, and keeps the merged branch's newest handoff on the base branch.

Fixes: run-record wave needs --story only for a /run-todo run (an ad-hoc /do drops it again); a gate run is logged only for a `node ... gate.js` invocation that runs a leg, not a command that merely names gate.js; session-handoff and /do agree that the handoff is written before the commit; a runtime without TaskCreate tracks the stages in the plan file; a headless browser fallback when the Playwright installer refuses the OS; corrected counts (50 workflows, 24 knowledge skills, 17 hook handlers) and the secret-scan gap note; the v6.15 note now says the detect-only job reads the last local gate result.

Migration: none required.

--- v6.15 ---
The software factory: /run-todo and /do now prove every story done before it is committed.

Features: each acceptance criterion can carry a `verify:` command; ac-verify records a red run before implementation, freezes the story's test files and bindings, and re-runs every binding itself (a run where no test passed is never met). ship-check seals the exact gated code and its records, and `commit.js --ship-check` refuses a commit when code, a frozen test, a binding or an earlier story's baseline changed after the seal, when the seal and commit name different stories, or when the wave review is missing. plan-check derives waves from dependencies, lists overlapping writers (they run in separate worktrees from local HEAD), validates the plan and orders later-slice stories after a Ship gate that waits for the owner's go. A failure ledger stops a third identical gate failure (the second gets one deep-tier retry), and a Budget line caps attempts, gate failures, dispatches and minutes per run. run-record, run-trace and a scoreboard measure each run; a scheduled detect-only job reads the last local gate result and files an intake note when it is red; the improvement loop (issue log, intake, verdict, protected set) applies only behind owner review. /todo, /run-todo and /do share one review cadence. fleet sync --adopter syncs one project. Skill profiles: fail-closed profiles, role allow-lists and leaner workflows.

Fixes: twelve frictions from the first real adopter run (path aliases and wave-wide modules in red runs, nested package-manager name filters, manual-only stories, root CLAUDE.md in --docs, dispatch counting and more).

Migration: none required. Stories without `verify:` lines still run; add them through /todo to get the proof. Write a wave's tests only when that wave starts.

--- v6.14 ---
Secret scanner: a moved, renamed or byte-identical copy of content that is already committed (or already on the remote) is no longer rescanned at commit or push, so moving a folder no longer re-raises old false positives. Any changed byte is still a new blob and is scanned.
